Admissions.heroEyebrow: Admissions · Open for the next batch
Admissions.heroBody: One short form. No payment, no obligation. We read every enquiry and call you back to plan the right track, batch timing and fee structure in person.
Admissions.discoveryTitle: The right batch starts with the right questions
Admissions.discoveryBody: The admission conversation is not a sales counter. It is a short review of the student's exam goal, present level, family context and support needs.
Admissions.step1Body: Share student, education, program and contact details in one place.
Admissions.step2Body: Within two working days, a mentor checks the right track, schedule and fees.
Admissions.step3Body: Sit in on a session, see the study hall, and confirm your seat for the batch.
Admissions.supportTitle: A mentor call before a commitment
Admissions.supportBody: Admissions should help the student choose correctly. The counselling call covers exam track, attempt date, medium, fee support and daily study expectations.
Admissions.faqBody: The most common questions are practical: track choice, family visits, medium, concessions and test-series access.
Admissions.nextUpBody: Need fee support before joining a batch? Check concession pathways for rural, farming, defence and repeat-attempt students.

About.heroBody: {name} is built for serious aspirants from Gangapur, Kolhapur district and nearby rural communities who need structure, mentoring and a place to study with purpose.
About.welcomeTitle: An academy shaped around the student who has to earn every attempt.
About.welcomeBody: Baliraja keeps the day practical: clear lectures, current-affairs routines, reading hours, mock tests and review conversations. The aim is not to impress students with complexity. It is to help them prepare consistently until the exam date arrives.
About.founderQuote: Baliraja exists for the student who is ready to work but needs the right room, the right guidance and the confidence that public service exams are not out of reach. Our duty is to keep preparation honest, disciplined and open to families who trust us with their child's attempt.
About.promiseBody: Baliraja's promise is simple and direct: teach well, mentor closely and keep rural students in the room long enough to compete with confidence.
About.methodTitle: Preparation is treated as a routine, not a slogan.
About.methodBody: Every exam track is broken into classes, reading, revision and test practice. Mentors help students choose a realistic route through the syllabus instead of trying to chase every notification at once.
About.supportTitle: The systems around the classroom matter.
About.supportBody: Aspirants need more than lectures. They need study space, review discipline, current affairs and honest feedback on where they stand.
About.nextUpBody: See the everyday spaces, routines and support systems that make Baliraja more than a timetable.
